title: HELIX Terminology: FLSA Status
description: Fair Labor Standards Act classification determining overtime eligibility.

codes.definition: Employee exempt from FLSA overtime provisions. Must meet both salary threshold ($35,568/year as of 2024 DOL rule, subject to judicial review) and duties test (executive, administrative, professional, computer, or outside sales exemption). Most faculty, administrators, and professional staff are exempt.

Employee entitled to FLSA overtime (1.5x regular rate for hours over 40 per workweek). Must track hours worked. Includes most clerical, technical, skilled trades, and service/maintenance workers. Student workers are typically non-exempt but may be FICA-exempt.

Faculty and instructors meeting the learned professional exemption for teaching. No salary threshold required for bona fide teachers. Primary duty must be teaching, tutoring, instructing, or lecturing.
